name: Ryugu
tagline: A spinning-top carbonaceous asteroid — sampled by Hayabusa2 and returned to Earth.
history: Ryugu is a rubble pile of the Solar System's oldest material — carbon-rich dust that escaped four billion years of geologic reprocessing. Hayabusa2 arrived in 2018, dropped rovers onto its boulder-strewn equator, blasted a crater to reach pristine subsurface material, and returned 5.4 grams to Earth in December 2020. Lab analysis found hydrated minerals and amino-acid precursors — direct evidence that asteroids seeded early Earth with life's ingredients.
